name: Super Speed Race noise generator
drawing: Motherboard schematic in the Super Speed Race Parts and Operating Manual (doc 8c0560561bb9) -- via MAME's netlist
revision: Super Speed Race motherboard, noise generator section: a CD4006 shift register with CD4070 feedback.
coverage: 2 ICs, 8 other parts and 14 nets over 40 pins. Converted from MAME's netlist: the noise generator only, a section of the motherboard. Its output goes to the audio board (sspeedr-sound). The board view carries the ICs and the nets between them; the board numbers its ICs rather than naming positions, so they are laid out in designator order, not where they sit.

origin.sourceLabel: The conversion, every change from MAME's file logged
origin.what: The netlist is MAME's -- written to simulate this board, from its schematics -- converted here into the board's own nets, with MAME's simulation stand-ins undone and, where this site holds the schematic, checked and corrected against it. The board view, chip lookup and bill of materials are made from it.
